svg.title: Core tables for receipts, reconciliation and closing (proposal)
svg.desc: A receipt sits in a book and joins a remittance. A fund has plans and plan lines. Bank lines sit under a statement. Reconciliations and periods refer to the same month.

g.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif
